Pivot Wheel.name: Pivot Wheel
Pivot Wheel.description: The user plants a foot, spins and releases the Quirk in a full circle around the user's body. Every opponent within arm's reach takes the Quirk's own damage type (bludgeoning damage from a strengthened body) and is pushed back out of reach; a Quirk with no attack applies its usual effect to each of them instead. Strain: moderate.
